title: Five Quiet Minutes
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Three
verse: "Come ye yourselves apart… and rest a while."

pages.text:
The house was full of stomping feet, of song and games and play —
and Mommy had been "MOMMY!" since the breaking of the day.

Jojo wanted Mommy. Pip did, too — and then some more.
And Baby Bee drummed pots and pans across the kitchen floor.

The TV blared, and Biscuit barked at every passing sound.
There wasn't one small quiet inch of quiet to be found.

And Mommy felt her ears go full, the way a cup can fill,
with one more drop, and one drop more, until it starts to spill.

So Mommy said, "I love you all. I need a little while —
just five quiet minutes, then I'll come back with a smile."

But Jojo's face fell. "Are you mad?" And Pip began to frown.
And Baby Bee, who wasn't sure, set her wobbly lip way down.

They followed her down every hall. They found her every place.
They peeked beneath the bathroom door to see her quiet space.

So Mommy knelt and pulled them close. "Now, let me make this clear:
me wanting quiet doesn't mean I don't want you all near.

I am not mad. I love you loud. I love you every day.
But Mommy's ears get full sometimes — they need a break from play.

A grown-up's like your tablet when the battery runs low:
she needs a quiet minute on the charger, then she'll glow.

It's not because I love you less. It's how I love you MORE —
a rested Mommy plays and laughs much better than before.

And quiet's good for you, as well — so come and rest with me:
a little hush, a little calm, is nice as nice can be."

So Jojo breathed. And Pip lay down. And Baby Bee gave a yawn.
And Biscuit curled up, nose to tail, till all the noise was gone.

Because your Mommy hugs and helps and gives the whole day through —
and Mommy needs a quiet rest… because she's human too.

verses: Be still, and know that I am God.
And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you.
It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
Her children arise up, and call her blessed.
